question: Can public recropping improve H-2147 or H-940 enough to strengthen the local 110 / Parpola sign-no.-41 branch?
result: No upgrade. H-2147 is weakened as a panel-level witness: raw PDF-image recropping shows the Figure 10.17 candidate is not a clean single-sign panel, but a multi-component panel whose right component was the earlier visual attraction. H-940 IIIF max and IA JP2 routes have the same pixel dimensions as the existing public page route and remain low-contrast/split. H-2148 remains the cleanest source-visible count-mapped 110 branch witness.

accepted_claims.h2147_object_route: H-2147 remains public object-visible through Figure 10.17 -> H95-2514.
accepted_claims.h2147_visual_weight: H-2147 may be used only as component-level visual pressure until source-side/sign notes map its visible components to local 673.1 or 673.2.
accepted_claims.h940_public_limit: H-940 B has no better public-resolution witness in the checked IA IIIF or JP2 routes.
accepted_claims.h2148_status: H-2148 remains public_visual_route_count_mapped and is the strongest current 110 branch target.

not_accepted: H-2147 lower panel is a clean single-sign panel
next_gate: Acquire H-2147 Figure 27.14/source-side notes and an independent better H-940 B source panel. Stop treating IA page derivatives as likely to solve H-940. If H-2147 stays multi-component and H-940 stays split, the branch becomes H-2148-led only until outside controls or source notes rescue it.
